title: TUI: launch a slice from a ready list
lead: Split out of S25 by #107 (ui.launch-split). The TUI launches a slice: the project offers a list of ready slices (ready = open, has a spec, no claim, no unmet dependency; the ! marker in slicer list), the owner picks one, answers the two y/n inputs (well specified, split), and the TUI shows the plan summary (lineup, check command) and the exact ork run command before a y/n confirm (Enter is No; ui.confirm #98). It calls run.plan, then run.start with the plan as Expected, as ork run does (internal/cli/run.go:119). Depends on S25 (action plumbing and the confirm bar) and S12 (a screen with a list).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner wants ork to be the one app that runs relays. S25 left launch out because the TUI has no screen to pick a slice from.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/launch.go` (new) and `internal/tui/launch_test.go` (new): the ready list, the two inputs, the plan summary, the confirm.
- `internal/tui/model.go`: runAction (:520-528) gains a launch case and a plan field. requestAction (:535-592) and callAction (:594-615) gain the launch path. Today requestAction needs an engine run on the row (:540), so launch uses its own entry.
- `internal/tui/view.go`: the confirm bar (:58-59) shows the exact `ork run PROJECT ITEM` command for launch.
- `internal/tui/live.go`: Live (:12-20) gains Plan and Start. Both take a project and an item, not a run ID; the comment at :10-11 must change.
- `internal/tui/daemon.go`: wrappers for Plan and Start beside Approve (:52-84), with the same Connect pattern.
- `internal/daemon/client.go`: no typed plan or start call exists (only Approve, Stop, Retry, Answer at :124-141 and Call at :119). Add Plan and Start there, using MethodRunPlan and MethodRunStart (runs.go:24-25), RunParams (runs.go:33-39) and RunPlan (runs.go:48-57).
- Test fakes that implement Live: actions_test.go:22-47 (actionLive) and pane_test.go:21. Each gains Plan and Start.
- `internal/tui/field.go`: textField (:12) for the two y/n inputs.
- The Roadmap view from S12 (roadmap.go) hosts the ready list.
- `testdata/golden/launch-100x30-color.txt` and launch-100x30-mono.txt (new).
- `docs/dashboard.md`: no launch text exists yet (rg finds none); add a launch paragraph.
- Reference only, no change: `internal/cli/run.go:37-130` (plan, print, confirm, start with Expected at :124-126).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestLaunchListsOnlyReadySlices: open, has a spec, no claim, no unmet dependency. Nothing else is listed.
- TestLaunchAsksWellSpecifiedAndSplit: picking a slice asks the two y/n inputs first; no plan call happens before both are answered.
- TestLaunchPlanBeforeConfirm: run.plan runs after the inputs and before the confirm; run.start has not run yet. The plan summary and the exact ork run command show in the confirm bar.
- TestLaunchYesStartsWithExpectedPlan: y calls run.start with Expected set to the plan from run.plan. Enter, n and esc start nothing.
- TestLaunchErrorVerbatim: a failed plan or start call shows its error code and message verbatim.
- TestActionExternalRows (existing, actions_test.go:167) still holds: runs started elsewhere offer no actions.
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write launch_test.go first from the Failing-tests above, with a fake Live that has Plan and Start. Run them and confirm they fail.
2. internal/daemon/client.go: add Plan(ctx, RunParams) returning *RunPlan, and Start(ctx, RunParams) returning runrec.Record, both through c.Call (:119-121).
3. tui/live.go: add Plan and Start to Live (:12-20). Update the comment at :10-11.
4. tui/daemon.go: add the wrappers, following the Connect pattern of Approve (:52-59).
5. Update the fakes: actions_test.go:22 and pane_test.go:21.
6. Ready list (launch.go): filter the Items in the project snapshot (source.go:69). Ready means status open, HasSlice, and no unmet dependency. The unmet-dependency check uses the Deps part from S12. Note: the list and deps output have no claim field, so the filter does not check one (record 140, `roadmap.readiness`, decided 2026-10-21: no claim).
7. Flow: pick a slice, answer the two inputs (textField, field.go:12), call Plan, then show the summary and the confirm bar.
8. Confirm: y calls Start with Expected set to the plan. Enter, n and esc cancel (model.go:302-304 already treats Enter as No, decision 98).
9. Add a launch case to runAction.command() (model.go:522-528) that prints `ork run PROJECT ITEM`, and carry the plan on runAction (model.go:520).
10. Errors go through actionError (model.go:617) without rewording.
11. Run go test ./internal/tui -update and review testdata/golden/launch-*.txt.
12. Add a launch paragraph to docs/dashboard.md.

Open: the key that opens the launch list, and the wording of the y/n prompts (the slice's own choice per the item text).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review testdata/golden/launch-100x30-color.txt and launch-100x30-mono.txt.
- Run TestLaunch* by name with go test -run.
- Check that the daemon test for run.plan and run.start (runs_test.go:93 and :109) still passes.
- slicer check
- adj lint
- [HUMAN CHECK] The owner launches one ready slice from the TUI on a test project and confirms the command shown matches the ork run command.
